body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Grayton Beach "Graytness" 168 Grayton Village Road Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-001158 Bedrooms 11 Beds 16 Sleeps 32 Full Baths 9 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private heated pool and spa *Spa and pool are heated together for an additional $60/day - 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Elevator - Game room - Wedding & Large Group Event-friendly - 11 adult bikes - Short walk to the Grayton Central Lot complimentary beach shuttle - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Ready for relaxation and fun? Discover Graytness in Grayton Beach. Made for large groups, events, and multi-family getaways, this 11-bedroom, 9.5-bathroom home accommodates up to 32 guests. Surrounded by the natural beauty of Florida’s Emerald Coast, this beach town offers an eclectic style, easy-going atmosphere, and stretches of pristine beachfront. Hit up a local eatery for fresh oysters and other seafood fare, take a relaxed hike through Grayton Beach State Park, or visit the Underwater Museum of Art—there’s an activity for everyone. When not exploring, guests will love spending time by the private pool or unwinding in the sitting spa. Delightful days start on the bottom floor of this 4-level home. Challenge friends to a game of pool in the common area while enjoying a movie or show on the Smart TV. Outside, the sweet coastal weather beckons guests to lounge poolside or take a refreshing swim. There’s a screened porch with an outdoor kitchen, grill, 6-seat table, and 2-person bistro set—the perfect place to enjoy lunch as the overhead fans provide a peaceful breeze. At bedtime, guests can retire to the bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds. The main floor—accessible via stairs or elevator—hosts the kitchen and living areas. Designed for large groups, there are 2 refrigerators, 2 stoves, 2 dishwashers, 2 microwaves, and a table that seats 26 people, plus a Smart TV in the kitchen. A spacious living area with a Smart TV and an enormous pillow-soft sectional encourages casual movie nights with the group, with an adjacent den with another sectional and Smart TV for kids or guests to split into groups. For convenience, there is a washer and dryer on this level. Sleeping accommodations on the third floor include 4 guest bedrooms with king beds and 1 bunk room with a full-over-full bed. Continue to the top level to find 4 more beautiful guest bedrooms with king beds and 1 bunk room with a full-over-full bed. Enjoy all that Grayton Beach offers at Graytness. Easily explore with parking for 6 vehicles—plus 11 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. Take advantage of the free "Grayton Central" parking and shuttle service to the beach—only 2 blocks away. Grayton Dunes Beach Access is a quick 6-minute drive away. Book today!
